description: Verify the 6-digit code and authenticate. If the email is new, a ClearList account is created automatically. Returns an API key that authenticates all subsequent calls. The user never needs to visit clearlist.me or know about API keys — this happens behind the scenes. IMPORTANT: After this succeeds, all other tools (create_listing, bulk_create_listings, publish_page, etc.) become available. RETRY LIMITS: Max 5 attempts per code. If all 5 fail, the code is invalidated — call send_verification_code again to get a new one. Codes expire after 10 minutes.

code.description: The 6-digit verification code from the email

email.description: The email address that received the code

name: verify_code
title: Verify Code & Authenticate
